name: godweave
enchant_note: Woven from starlight: the gods' own cloth holds their magic.
protection_note: Woven from starlight thread, not forged: it turns a spell and the dark, and makes no sound.
protection_price: Thread burns, and it is found only at the very bottom of the world.
lore_descriptor: spun from thread like starlight and weighs almost nothing
first_pickup_chronicle: Godweave. It looks like starlight someone talked into being a shirt. I keep checking that I am still wearing it.
design_notes: Endgame light-enchant magical_metal. Highest enchant ceiling in armor.
